name: How long does a main water line replacement typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a main water line replacement typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a main water line replacement can vary based on factors like the length of the line, the depth of the burial, and the type of soil. Most standard replacements can be completed within one to three days. Complex projects involving extensive excavation or municipal coordination, especially in densely populated areas like parts of Las Vegas or Henderson, might require more time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most main water line replacements take 1-3 days, though complex projects can take longer depending on site conditions.
